# layrz_theme

**Tag**: flutter, layrz, styling, materialdesign, goldenm, mobile, ui

## 简介

Layrz standard styling library for Flutter. Widget library following the Material Design 3 guidelines, with a focus on reliavility and functionality.

## 官网

- 主页: https://theme.layrz.com
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/goldenm-software/layrz_theme
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/layrz_theme
